security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: DayZ server browser and mod manager for Linux
bundle.longDescription: Balota lists every DayZ server, resolves the mods each one requires, subscribes to them through Steam and launches the game with the symlinks Proton needs to load them.
